rawText:
Found 54 items in registries @better-auth-ui:

Showing items 1-54 of 54:

- auth-provider (registry:component) - Wraps the Better Auth UI provider and mounts an ErrorToaster that surfaces query and mutation failures via sonner. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- additional-field (registry:component) - Renders a configured additional user field on the sign-up form and user profile, with support for string, number, boolean, date, datetime, select, combobox, slider, and hidden types. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sign-in (registry:component) - A complete sign-in form component with email/password and social provider support. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- anonymous (registry:component) - Adds a Continue as guest button backed by Better Auth's anonymous plugin. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-auth (registry:component) - Capability approval and grant revocation UI for Better Auth Agent Auth. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sso (registry:component) - Discovers organization SSO from an email address and manages organization identity providers and domain verification. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- last-login-method (registry:component) - Adds a localized last-used indicator to email and social sign-in methods tracked by Better Auth. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- one-tap (registry:item) - Updates the authentication surfaces with the headless prompt slot used by the Google One Tap UI plugin. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sign-up (registry:component) - A complete sign-up form component with name, email, password fields, and social provider support. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- email-otp (registry:component) - Email OTP plugin: passwordless sign-in with an emailed code, plus code-based replacements for email verification, password reset, and email changes. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- phone-number (registry:component) - Phone-number plugin with verification-code and password sign-in, password recovery, and verified phone-number management. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- magic-link (registry:component) - Magic-link plugin: passwordless email sign-in form, toggle button between password and magic-link routes, and the AuthPlugin scaffolding that registers the view with `<Auth>`. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- billing (registry:component) - Provider-neutral plans, subscription, portal, seats, cancellation, restoration, and usage settings with Stripe and Polar adapters. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dash (registry:component) - Filtered personal, organization, and administrator audit logs backed by Better Auth Infrastructure Dash. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- oauth-provider (registry:component) - OAuth Provider plugin: authorization screens, connected applications, and personal or organization OAuth client management. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- device-authorization (registry:component) - Device authorization plugin: code entry, sign-in continuation, and approve or deny actions for Better Auth device requests. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- username (registry:component) - Username plugin: username-based sign-in form and availability checking field. Registers a sign-in view that accepts both username and email, and a username field with real-time availability checking rendered on the sign-up form. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- passkey (registry:component) - Passkey plugin: WebAuthn sign-in button and passkey management card. Registers a passkey sign-in button on the sign-in form and a Passkeys security card in account settings. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- siwe (registry:component) - ERC-4361 wallet sign-in with optional email collection and server-authorized wallet account management. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- two-factor (registry:component) - Two-factor plugin: the post-password challenge for authenticator, emailed, and backup codes, plus the settings card for enrollment and backup-code management. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- api-key (registry:component) - API Key plugin: list, create, copy, and revoke API keys. Registers an API Keys security card in account settings. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- admin (registry:component) - Static administration shell with user management, a user inspector, session controls, and the stop-impersonating action. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- multi-session (registry:component) - Multi-session plugin: Enable multiple concurrent sessions with account switching. Registers account management cards in account settings and a switch account submenu in the user button. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- organization (registry:component) - Organization plugin: multi-tenant organization management with members, invitations, and roles. Registers direct invitation acceptance, an organizations settings tab, a full `<Organization />` shell, and an `<OrganizationSwitcher />` dropdown. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- theme (registry:component) - Theme plugin: theme-library agnostic theme selection. Registers an Appearance card in account settings and a theme toggle in the user button. Pass `useTheme` from your theme library (e.g. next-themes) or static `setTheme`. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- delete-user (registry:component) - Delete-user plugin: danger zone with DeleteAccount card and confirmation dialog. Registers a DangerZone security card in account settings when the plugin is registered. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- forgot-password (registry:component) - A form component for requesting a password reset link via email. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- reset-password (registry:component) - A form component for resetting password with a token from the URL. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- verify-email (registry:component) - A page prompting the user to verify their email, with a button to open their email provider and a resend button rate-limited by a cooldown timer. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- auth-redirect (registry:component) - A session-aware redirect view that safely continues authenticated users to a same-origin target or sends them through sign in first. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sign-out (registry:component) - A component that signs the user out when mounted and displays a loading state. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- auth (registry:component) - A unified authentication component that renders the appropriate auth view based on path or view prop. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- user-avatar (registry:component) - Renders the current user's avatar using session data. Shows a skeleton while loading and falls back to initials when no image is available. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- user-view (registry:component) - Renders a user view that shows the user's avatar alongside their name and email. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- user-button (registry:component) - Renders a user button with dropdown menu showing user info, settings link, plugin-contributed menu items (e.g. theme toggle, account switcher), and sign-in/sign-out actions. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- user-profile (registry:component) - A form component for editing user profile information including name and avatar. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- change-email (registry:component) - A form component for changing the user's email address with verification. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- account-settings (registry:component) - A container component that displays account settings including user profile, change email, and plugin-contributed account cards (e.g. appearance from the theme plugin, multi-session accounts). [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- change-password (registry:component) - A form component for users to change their password with current password verification. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- linked-accounts (registry:component) - Display and manage linked social accounts. Shows all linked social accounts with the ability to unlink them, followed by available providers that can be linked. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- active-sessions (registry:component) - Display and manage all active sessions for the current user with revoke controls. Shows each session's browser, OS, and creation time. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- security-settings (registry:component) - A container component that displays security settings including password management, linked accounts, plugin-contributed security cards (e.g. passkeys), active sessions, and danger zone. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- settings (registry:component) - A unified settings component that renders the appropriate settings view based on path or view prop with tab navigation. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- email-verification-email (registry:component) - Email template component that sends email verification links to users. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- magic-link-email (registry:component) - Email template component that sends magic link authentication emails for passwordless sign-in. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- reset-password-email (registry:component) - Email template component that sends password reset links to users. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- change-email-confirmation-email (registry:component) - Email template component for approving an email address change from the current address. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- delete-account-verification-email (registry:component) - Email template component for verifying a permanent account deletion request. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- password-changed-email (registry:component) - Email template component that notifies users when their password has been changed. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- email-changed-email (registry:component) - Email template component that notifies users when their email address has been changed. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- otp-email (registry:component) - Email template component that sends one-time password (OTP) verification codes to users. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- new-device-email (registry:component) - Email template component that notifies users when a new device signs in to their account. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- organization-invitation-email (registry:component) - Email template component that invites a user to join an organization. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- all (registry:item) - Installs every Better Auth UI component, plugin, and email template in one shot. [@better-auth-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
